name: M
notes: M0 base stable-token candidate. Verify issuer and minter roles, eligible collateral and validator framework, earning versus non-earning balances, launch chronology, deployments, reserve reporting, and whether M should remain separate from M0-branded extension tokens. Primary source lead: https://docs.m0.org/protocol/m-token

name: Falcon USD
notes: Overcollateralized synthetic-dollar candidate. Verify operator and legal entities, classic and innovative mint paths, collateral custody, liquidation and redemption restrictions, reserve transparency, launch date, deployments, and relationship to sUSDf. Primary source lead: https://docs.falcon.finance/mechanism/usdf-synthetic-dollar

name: dForce USX
notes: Protocol-stablecoin candidate. Verify historical hybrid issuance and current overcollateralized model, 1:1 stablecoin mint and redemption paths, governance, peg events, canonical omnichain deployment, launch chronology, and separation from sUSX. Primary source lead: https://docs.dforce.network/ecosystem/usx-stablecoin

name: Anzen USDz
notes: RWA-backed tokenized-dollar candidate. Verify issuer and bankruptcy-remote structure, private-credit collateral eligibility and valuation, mint and redemption restrictions, reserve transparency, launch date, deployments, and separation from staked USDz. Primary source lead: https://docs.anzen.finance/usdz-101/overview

name: Avalon USDa
notes: Bitcoin-backed CDP stablecoin candidate. Verify collateral custody and CeDeFi boundary, mint and redemption access, liquidation and oracle design, operator entities, launch chronology, canonical omnichain deployments, reserve disclosures, and relationship to yield-bearing representations.
